Both changes are applied and validated.

**`~/.pi/agent/settings.json`** — added the `subagents` block (defaultModel `openai-codex/gpt-5.6-luna`, overrides for `reviewer`/`oracle`, cursor agents disabled). `packages` already contained `npm:pi-subagents` and `npm:pi-mcp-adapter`, and both referenced models were already in `enabledModels`, so nothing else needed changing.

**`~/.pi/agent/extensions/subagent/config.json`** — created new (directory didn't exist) with the compact tool descriptions, summary inline display, pruned fork context on `gpt-5.6-luna:max`, and worktree base dir.

Two notes:
- `~/.pi/agent/agents/` doesn't exist here. That's fine — pi-subagents writes it on first use, and the `agentOverrides` in settings.json are authoritative.
- `claude-sdk/claude-5-opus` and `claude-sdk/claude-5-sonnet` are enabled in settings, but the fallbacks only fire if the claude-sdk provider is authenticated on this machine.

Restart pi to pick both up.
